data.one_liner: Flutter widget for displaying animated wave backgrounds with custom color, duration, and effects.
data.what_it_does: Provides a WaveWidget that renders customizable animated wave backgrounds. Supports multiple configuration modes including single colors, random generator seeds, and explicit custom colors or gradients per layer.
use_when: You want to display animated wave backgrounds in your app
You need customizable wave amplitude, frequency, and phase effects
You want to generate wave configurations visually using an online or example-app demo
avoid_when: You need data management, networking, or state-management logic
strengths: Simple declarative API with SingleConfig, RandomConfig, and CustomConfig
Supports customizable gradients, durations, and layer heights
Cross-platform support including web, mobile, and desktop platforms
weaknesses: Focused entirely on wave animations rather than a comprehensive widget kit
data.minimal_example:
WaveWidget(
  config: SingleConfig(
    color: Color(0xFF00BBF9),
    layers: 3,
  ),
  size: Size(double.infinity, double.infinity),
)
